blocks.en: This page serves as a central hub for information about earning ISK (Interstellar Kredits), the primary in-game currency of EVE Online. There are many different ways to make ISK, ranging from combat to industry, exploration, trade, and beyond. This page provides an overview of key income sources, tools, and general guidance for players seeking to improve their financial position in-game.
blocks.zh: 本页是关于赚取 ISK（星际信用币，Interstellar Kredits）的信息汇总入口，ISK 是 EVE Online 中最主要的游戏货币。赚 ISK 的方式有很多，从战斗到工业、探索、贸易等等。本页概述了主要的收入来源、工具，以及为想要改善游戏内财务状况的玩家提供的一般性建议。

blocks.en: EVE Online offers a wide variety of opportunities for players to earn ISK. Income activities vary significantly in terms of required skills, starting capital, time investment, and risk. Some methods are relatively passive and low-risk, while others are high-effort but potentially more profitable. Most players earn ISK through a combination of activities depending on their interests, available time, and in-game goals.
blocks.zh: EVE Online 为玩家提供了各种各样赚 ISK 的机会。不同收入活动在所需技能、启动资金、时间投入和风险方面差别很大。有些方式相对被动、风险较低，有些则投入大但潜在收益更高。大多数玩家会根据自己的兴趣、可用时间和游戏目标，组合多种活动来赚 ISK。

blocks.en: Below are the broad categories of ISK-making activities in EVE Online:
blocks.zh: 以下是 EVE Online 中赚 ISK 活动的大致分类：

en: Missions – Earning ISK through PVE combat missions from NPC agents.
Exploration – Scanning down cosmic signatures to find relic/data sites, wormholes, or combat anomalies.
Mining – Harvesting ore, gas, or ice for sale or industry use.
Industry – Manufacturing items from raw materials, including ships, modules, and ammunition.
Planetary Industry – Passive income generation from planetary colonies.
Trade – Buying and selling items for profit via regional and inter-regional markets.
Hauling – Transporting goods between locations for personal or contracted payment.
Abyssal Deadspace – High-risk, high-reward PVE activity for up to 3 pilots with time-limited arenas.
Incursions – Group PVE content involving the defeat of Sansha Nation forces for significant rewards.
Ratting – Combat-focused income from killing NPC pirates, often in nullsec or anomalies.
PvP – Income gained from looting player wrecks or ransoming player assets (e.g. in wormholes).
DED Sites and Escalations – Special high-value combat sites with potential rare loot.
zh: 任务 – 通过完成 NPC 代理人发布的 PVE 战斗任务赚取 ISK。
探索 – 扫描宇宙信号，寻找遗迹/数据站点、虫洞或战斗异常。
采矿 – 采集矿石、气云或冰矿，用于出售或工业生产。
工业 – 用原材料制造物品，包括舰船、装备和弹药。
行星开发 – 通过行星殖民地获得被动收入。
贸易 – 在星域内及跨星域市场低买高卖赚取利润。
运输 – 在不同地点之间运送货物，为自己或按合同收取报酬。
深渊 – 高风险高回报的 PVE 活动，最多 3 名飞行员参与，场地有时间限制。
入侵 – 击败萨沙共和国部队的团队 PVE 内容，奖励丰厚。
刷怪 – 以战斗为主的收入方式，击杀 NPC 海盗，通常在 00 区或异常中进行。
PvP – 通过拾取玩家残骸或勒索玩家资产（例如在虫洞中）获得收入。
DED 站点与升级任务 – 特殊的高价值战斗站点，可能掉落稀有战利品。

blocks.en: New players may wish to begin with activities that have low skill and ship requirements:
blocks.zh: 新玩家可以先从技能和舰船要求较低的活动开始：

en: Level 1–2 missions
Highsec combat or data/relic exploration
Venture mining in asteroid belts
Career Agents missions (tutorial chains)
Distribution missions (low-risk hauling)
zh: 1–2 级任务
高安战斗站点或数据/遗迹探索
驾驶冲锋者级在小行星带采矿
生涯代理人任务（教程任务链）
物流任务（低风险运输）

blocks.en: These provide early ISK while introducing key game mechanics, but they are low ISK making activities. So you should move on from these once you have the skills and experience.
blocks.zh: 这些活动能在早期提供一些 ISK，同时帮你熟悉关键的游戏机制，但它们赚钱效率很低。所以一旦有了相应的技能和经验，就应该转向其他活动。

blocks.en: Different income sources have varying entry barriers:
blocks.zh: 不同收入来源的门槛各不相同：

en: Low Skill / Low Capital: Highsec mining, level 1 missions, data sites, courier contracts
Medium Skill / Medium Capital: Abyssal sites, relic sites in nullsec, level 3–4 missions, small-scale trading
High Skill / High Capital: Incursions, industry chains, nullsec ratting, T2 manufacturing, large-scale hauling
zh: 低技能 / 低资金：高安采矿、1 级任务、数据站点、快递合同
中等技能 / 中等资金：深渊站点、00 区遗迹站点、3–4 级任务、小规模贸易
高技能 / 高资金：入侵、工业产业链、00 区刷怪、T2 制造、大规模运输

blocks.en: While some methods are relatively passive (e.g. Planetary Industry), others may require frequent interaction or participation in fleets.
blocks.zh: 有些方式相对被动（例如行星开发），而另一些可能需要频繁操作或参加舰队。

blocks.en: Generally, activities in more dangerous space (lowsec, nullsec, wormholes) offer higher potential profits, but also come with increased risk of PvP and ship loss. Many income sources also vary over time depending on market conditions and game changes.
blocks.zh: 一般来说，在更危险的空间（低安、00 区、虫洞）进行的活动潜在利润更高，但遭遇 PvP 和损失舰船的风险也更大。许多收入来源的收益还会随着市场状况和游戏改动而变化。

blocks.en: The following tools and sites can assist with income generation:
blocks.zh: 以下工具和网站可以帮助你赚钱：

en: Janice – Estimate the value of loot or inventory
Innominate App – Appraise Eve assets and Ore reprocessing value
Eve Tycoon – Trade and industry profitability tracking
zh: Janice – 估算战利品或库存的价值
Innominate App – 估算 EVE 资产价值和矿石提炼价值
Eve Tycoon – 跟踪贸易和工业的盈利情况
